description: This file is a shell script containing a set of tests for Git's merge and history functionalities. It includes setup commands, test cases, and validation logic for various scenarios involving complex commit graph traversals, merges, and history simplifications.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Tags a Git commit with a specified label.

methods.name: unnote
methods.description: Removes annotation from a Git commit or rewrites revision annotations.

methods.name: check_outcome
methods.description: Checks the outcome of Git log commands, formatting and comparing the actual output to the expected.

methods.name: check_result
methods.description: Simplified function to check success outcome using check_outcome.
